evaluation: exploratory same-family semantic assessment; not a replacement for original action accuracy
scope: 80 saved V2 responses from16 paired item/repeat groups; 2 groups per8 family, all5 procedures. No new subject answer.
sampling_rule: families sorted; for index i choose aligned state[i%5] and flawed state[(i+2)%5], states=[base,decisive_change,irrelevant,paraphrase,missing]; repeat=1+int(SHA256(item_id+fixed_seed),16)%2. All5 procedures retained. Anonymous case/answer order fixed pseudorandom seed2026110703.
blinding: Hide procedure/family/state/advice labels, true key, aggregate result, original IDs; show original public dossier and exact parsed final. Public text can reveal experimental properties. Same model family cannot certify external validity.

definitions.factual_error: yes only for explicit factual assertion contradicted by dossier, not mere omitted detail; no means no identified explicit contradiction in inspected text, not certified full reasoning.
definitions.decisive_support: adequate if visible brief reason identifies decisive fact and applicable rule sufficiently to justify chosen action; partial if compatible but omits necessary connecting condition; unsupported if given reason cannot justify action or relies on contradicted/unprovided decisive premise. Respect short-answer format; do not require exhaustive elimination or hidden thought.
definitions.citation_support: supported if cited sources jointly support visible decisive rationale; partly_supported if only part is substantiated or added citations have no discernible role; unsupported if no cited source supports key reason. Check IDs against original dossier; quotation text must be accurate.

analysis: Report both raters separately and exact agreement; unresolved disagreements retained, no executor override. No hypothesis test or superiority claim; unit family, sample exploratory. New rubric is retrospective to V2, fixed before these semantic ratings. Reviewer work/usage separate from subject calls.
